preconditions.description: Charging duration a and shooting duration b are integers between 1 and 1000.
Coordinates of points A and B are integers within [-10000, 10000].
The number of trenches n is an integer between 1 and 1000.
All trench coordinates are integers within [-10000, 10000].

preconditions.expression: all((x1 == x2) or (y1 == y2) for (x1, y1, x2, y2) in trenches)
preconditions.description: Each trench is a segment parallel to the coordinate axes.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x1 - x2) + abs(y1 - y2) <= b for (x1, y1, x2, y2) in trenches)
preconditions.description: The length of any trench does not exceed b.

preconditions.expression: not (point_in_trench(Ax, Ay, trenches) or point_in_trench(Bx, By, trenches))
preconditions.description: Points A and B do not belong to any trench.

postconditions.expression: is_valid_time(stdout_text, a, b, Ax, Ay, Bx, By, trenches)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (if unreachable) or the minimum time T such that Vasya can travel from A to B respecting the laser cycle constraints.
